test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Ravindra starts from Point Y and drives 18 km towards north. He then takes a right turn, drives 45 km, turns right and drives 42 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 26 km. He takes a right turn, drives 89 km. He then turns left, drives 19 km to stop at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again?

All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given:

Ravindra starts from Point Y (0, 0)

18 km North

Right turn → 45 km East

Right turn → 42 km South

Right turn → 26 km West

Right turn → 89 km North

Left turn → 19 km West

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3992e8dd42bb9bf308a27263a1ba9cdbb7d58a7b664a22c1ff008e216ca68a5.png] 

So, To return to Point Y, Ravindra must move 65 km South.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
